messages: Anya L: Quick design sync — proposing we regroup the left bar into three zones (Workflows / Registry / Settings) to flatten depth and make link-sharing simpler. Sketch + notes: https://figma.com/s/leftbar-zones. Thoughts? Tom H: Sounds good. Two quick infra questions: how do we want the URL surface to represent these zones? Full path (/p/:id/registry), query (?zone=registry) or fragment (#zone=registry)? Each has tradeoffs for analytics and SSR. Sam R: Leaning toward path because it makes links clearly shareable and easier to tie to feature flags. But path changes require route redirects for older links. Jiro K: Fragment/hash is easiest for the SPA (no server changes) and we can read it on load, but server can't see it. If we need server-level canonical URLs we should put zone in path or query. Maria P: Accessibility nits: whichever approach we pick, we must: 1) set focus to the first heading in the main pane on deep-link load, 2) add aria-current="page" on the active leftbar item, and 3) ensure keyboard nav remains consistent when sections collapse/expand. Also prefer visible focus ring on zone headers. design-bot: Poll: which URL pattern do you prefer? :ballot_box: 1) Path (/p/:id/registry) 2) Query (/p/:id?zone=registry) 3) Fragment (/p/:id#zone=registry). (vote in thread) Nina QA: Note bugs to watch for: back/forward with anchors (some browsers reset scroll), project-switch race where anchor points to missing section, and analytics duplication if both path+fragment get emitted. We'll need automated e2e tests for each pattern. Tom H: Implementation idea: prioritize path for canonical/shareable links, keep fragment for ephemeral UI state (collapsed/expanded). Proposed contract: canonical = /p/:projectId/zone/:zoneId; ephemeral = #collapsed=true. Example: `/p/123/zone/registry#collapsed=false`. Jiro K: Frontend plan: support both for backward compatibility. Route parsing order: path -> query -> hash. When we detect legacy query/hash, we issue a soft replaceState to canonical path so old links still work but we normalize URLs. Will add telemetry on normalization. Sam R: Copy tweak suggestion: leftbar label 'Models' -> 'Model Registry' in full mode, collapsed label shortened to 'Registry' to avoid wrapping. Breadcrumbs should use compact variant 'Registry'. Maria P: Confirm screen-reader text: visible label plus sr-only suffix when collapsed, e.g., `, current` with aria-current. Also ensure live region announcements for zone changes when navigated via keyboard. Anya L: Agree on the copy tweak. Also: proposal to add a subtle divider between zones and an affordance icon (three-dot group) to indicate grouping. Will update mockups. Nina QA: I'll add these checks to the regression checklist: deep-link load focus, history navigation, legacy-link normalization, analytics events deduped. Tom H: Action items: 1) Jiro prototype route parsing + soft-redirects, 2) Anya update Figma and provide final copy strings, 3) Nina add QA tests, 4) Sam file product ticket for rollout + docs. I'll create the tickets and assign. Jiro K: Quick tech note — collapsing state persisted in localStorage only (not in canonical URL) to avoid proliferation of link variants. We can still expose collapse in fragment if product insists. Anya L: Small copy question: breadcrumb root should read 'Projects' or 'Workspace'? leaning 'Projects' for clarity. Opinions? Sam R: 'Projects' is fine. 'Workspace' confuses people who expect project-level scoping. Maria P: +1 'Projects'. Also add `role="navigation" aria-label="Left navigation"` on the leftbar element. Anya L: Thanks everyone — I'll post updated screens and the preferred canonical route spec in this thread once done. :sparkles:
